title: Muxed address from ID -1 must be refused
why: MuxedAccount.med25519.id is a uint64; a builder that accepts a value no uint64 equals encodes some other ID, and the muxed address then routes to a different sub-account than the caller meant.
notes: Built by xdrcheck-corpus synth from corpus/recipes/cap-0027/api-muxed-account-id-encoding.id-negative.json. Origin: probe vector 2m4, in evidence/sdk-matrix/vectors/vectors.json, executed in every probe column (evidence/sdk-matrix). A uint64 has no negative values; a builder that wraps -1 encodes 2^64-1. Expected values were computed from the XDR definitions, the CAP or SEP text and the stellar-core rule cited under related, with an independent encoder; no SDK output was used.
